prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: could we please get to the gate?
Delta: Good morning. How may I assist you?  *AJL

Customer: ATL, Gate A31 to San Diego, gate agent Richard is fantastic! His enthusiasm is infectious
Delta: Hi, Ryan, thank you so much for the shout out to Richard. I will forward your comments to his Leadership Team, thank you for taking the time to recognize him.  *TRR

Customer: the crew on dL flight 70 has been fantastic.
Delta: Keep up the awesome job DL70 crew! #KeepClimbing *HKM

Customer: Thanks for the fantastic first flying experience with our son, ! https://t.co/0725DxAqhe
Delta: We are thrilled to be part of this milestone! Thanks for trusting Delta and sharing this great photo. ✈ *TJE

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: praise):
"""The gate team working DL5703 0815 LAX Gate 36 is fantastic. Just what you hope for when flying."""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Thank you for the kind words about our gate team on DL5703 at LAX Gate 36. We’ll be sure to share your feedback with them!
